history.text:
Tentu, ini lirik lagu "Heaven and Back" oleh Dean Lewis:

**(Verse 1)**
I'm driving down the road, it's a quarter past three
And I'm thinking about you and me
We were young and we were wild
We were reckless and we were free
Now I'm lost and I'm alone
And I don't know where to go

**(Pre-Chorus)**
'Cause I've been to heaven and back
And I've seen the light
But I'm still stuck in the dark
And I can't find my way

**(Chorus)**
I'm looking for a way to get back to you
I'm looking for a way to get back to you
I'm looking for a way to get back to you
I'm looking for a way to get back to you

**(Verse 2)**
I remember the first time I saw your face
It was like a dream, a beautiful embrace
We danced all night under the stars
And I knew right then that you were the one

**(Pre-Chorus)**
'Cause I've been to heaven and back
And I've seen the light
But I'm still stuck in the dark
And I can't find my way

**(Chorus)**
I'm looking for a way to get back to you
I'm looking for a way to get back to you
I'm looking for a way to get back to you
I'm looking for a way to get back to you

**(Bridge)**
I've tried to move on, but it's no use
Everywhere I go, I see your ghost
This pain inside me, it won't fade
I'm trapped in this nightmare, I can't escape

**(Chorus)**
I'm looking for a way to get back to you
I'm looking for a way to get back to you
I'm looking for a way to get back to you
I'm looking for a way to get back to you

**(Outro)**
I'm looking for a way
To get back to you
I'm looking for a way
To get back to you
